stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Drax break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. They trade insults constantly but fight side by side.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After years together, Drax leaves the team in Rocket's hands.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's longtime teammate, left in charge of the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's longtime teammate. Leaves the team in Rocket's hands.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Aboard the Benatar, Drax and Rocket tease Quill about his weight while the Guardians look after the rescued Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who joins Drax in teasing Quill about his weight.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who joins Rocket in teasing Quill about his weight.

their_evidence: Benatar, after Thor is brought aboard: Drax and Rocket talk about Quill's weight gain while the team works out how Thor survived.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark brings in F.R.I.D.A.Y. to replace J.A.R.V.I.S. after Ultron's attack. She runs his suits and labs and becomes the voice at his side in every fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who brings her in to replace J.A.R.V.I.S.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I. after J.A.R.V.I.S., running his suits and labs.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs the simulation that cracks time travel for Tony. After he uses the Stones to beat Thanos, she reports to Pepper that his life functions are critical as he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, whose dying moments she reports after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who helps him crack time travel and reports him dying.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Tony has F.R.I.D.A.Y. clear New York's streets as Thanos's ship arrives, and she patches Pepper's call through as he follows the ship into space.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s boss, whose call from Pepper she relays as he leaves Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who clears New York's streets and relays Pepper's call.

their_evidence: New York: 'F.R.I.D.A.Y., evac anyone south of 43rd Street, notify first responders.' 'Will do.' Then 'Boss, incoming call from Miss Potts' and 'Boss, we're losing her' as Tony rides the Q-Ship out of the atmosphere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar, escape the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. Groot gives his life to shield the team when the Dark Aster crashes.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, who gives his life to shield the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, first met brawling over the Orb on Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gamora looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, whom Gamora looks out for as a youngster.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, who looks out for Groot in battle.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Groot swears at Quill over his game aboard the Benatar, Gamora and the rest of the crew react in shock.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teenage teammate whose swearing shocks Gamora and the crew.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who reacts in shock when Groot swears at Quill.

their_evidence: Benatar: Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot answers rudely and the crew (dialogue credited to Star-Lord, Groot, Gamora, Drax and Rocket) reacts in an uproar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis arrives with Ego to meet Quill and Gamora, and she joins the Guardians after they defeat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ego's ward, who joins the Guardians after his defeat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian Mantis meets with Ego, and joins after his defeat.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Mantis goes with Gamora to Knowhere to stop Thanos, and Thanos strikes Mantis down as he takes Gamora captive.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Goes with Gamora to Knowhere. Struck down as Thanos takes her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Thanos takes captive on Knowhere.

their_evidence: Knowhere: Quill, Gamora, Drax and Mantis confront Thanos; as he takes Gamora hostage the Guardians try to save her and he takes out Drax and Mantis with the Reality Stone.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot crash Gamora's attempt to steal the Orb from Quill on Xandar, and they all land in the Kyln. They escape together and become founding members of the Guardians.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian who crashes Gamora's Orb heist on Xandar.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian whose Orb heist Rocket crashes on Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Rocket, helps the Guardians hunt for the code to save his life, and on Counter-Earth she shields the dying Rocket from Adam Warlock and War Pig.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she shields while he lies dying.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014, a stranger who shields Rocket while he lies dying.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Rocket asks why the Guardians are answering a distress call, Gamora tells him someone could be dying, and the rescue brings them to Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Asks why they answer the distress call. Gamora says someone could be dying.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Rocket they answer the distress call because someone could be dying.

their_evidence: Opening of the Guardians' storyline: 'Why are we doing this again?' 'It's a distress signal, Rocket. Someone could be dying.' (Rocket and Gamora).

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Aboard the Benatar, Quill orders Groot to put his game away, and Groot swears at him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Groot to put his game away and gets sworn at.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teenage teammate who swears at Quill over his game.

their_evidence: Benatar: 'Groot, put that thing away, now. I don't want to tell you again.' 'I am Groot.' Groot rudely insults Quill's demand to focus on the mission.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: When Vanko takes over Rhodes's War Machine armor at the Stark Expo, Natasha, undercover at Stark Industries, breaks into Hammer's system and gives him back control.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Undercover S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who gives Rhodes back control of his armor.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: War Machine, whose armor Natasha frees from Vanko's control.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes and Natasha Romanoff fight side by side against Ultron in Sokovia, and both join the new Avengers.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger who fights beside Rhodes in Sokovia.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who fights beside Natasha in Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Natasha are among the few Avengers left, and they keep working side by side from the Avengers compound.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend and one of the few Avengers still standing after the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend and one of the few Avengers still standing after the Snap.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Natasha and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight side by side in Wakanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Rhodes refuses to arrest, then fights beside in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Natasha and fights beside her in Wakanda.

their_evidence: At the compound Ross demands Rogers, Wilson, Romanoff, Vision and Maximoff be arrested; Rhodes cuts the transmission and greets his old teammates. Both fight in the Battle of Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes and Sam Wilson join the new Avengers together after the fight in Sokovia.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow member of the new Avengers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow member of the new Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey and Sam end up on opposite sides over the Sokovia Accords. Rhodey is chasing Sam at the Leipzig airport when Vision accidentally shoots him down.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A rival over the Accords. Rhodes is chasing him in Leipzig when Vision accidentally downs Rhodes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A rival over the Accords, shot down while chasing Sam in Leipzig.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#1
stages.text: Rhodey and Sam are friends again, and after Sam gives up Steve's shield, Rhodey talks frankly with him about it.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend again. Rhodes talks frankly with him about giving up the shield.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend again, who talks frankly with Sam about giving up the shield.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Sam and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight on the same side in Wakanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Back on Rhodes's side. Rhodes refuses to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Back on Sam's side. Refuses Ross's order to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.

their_evidence: Compound scene: Ross orders the arrivals (incl. Wilson) arrested, Rhodes cuts him off, which may end his career, and greets his old teammates; both then defend Wakanda. Turns the Civil War rivalry back to alliance.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision and James Rhodes are fellow Avengers who both back the Sokovia Accords. At the Leipzig airport Vision's misfired beam knocks Rhodey out of the sky, leaving him paralyzed.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger whose misfired beam leaves Rhodes paralyzed.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger whom Vision's misfired beam leaves paralyzed.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When the wounded Vision reaches the Avengers compound, Rhodes refuses Ross's order to arrest him and the others. Rhodes then fights in Wakanda to keep Thanos's army away from Vision while Shuri works on the Mind Stone.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Rhodes shelters from Ross, then fights to protect in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Vision, then fights to protect him in Wakanda.

their_evidence: Ross is outraged at Vision's disappearance; Rhodes says it is the Accords' fault, then cuts Ross off when he orders the group (incl. Vision) arrested. The Avengers and Wakandans fight to buy Shuri time to remove the Stone from Vision.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku and Okoye end up on the same side against Erik Killmonger. When W'Kabi charges M'Baku with a war rhino, Okoye steps in front of the animal and stops it.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The general who stops a war rhino charging M'Baku.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader Okoye saves from a war rhino.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: As Thanos's army gathers outside the dome, M'Baku tells Okoye this will be the end of Wakanda, and she answers that it will be the noblest ending in history. They fight side by side in the battle that follows.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tells M'Baku the coming battle will be the noblest ending in history.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Warns Okoye that the coming battle will be the end of Wakanda.

their_evidence: Quoted exchange: "This will be the end of Wakanda." / "Then it will be the noblest ending in history." (M'Baku and Okoye), followed by the Battle of Wakanda; both survive the Snap on the field.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku challenges T'Challa for the throne in ritual combat and loses, and T'Challa spares him. When Killmonger takes over, M'Baku shelters the wounded T'Challa and brings his Jabari warriors to help win Wakanda back.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The king who spares M'Baku in combat, whom he later shelters.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's challenger, whom he spares and who shelters him in turn.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When T'Challa warns of the coming attack, M'Baku brings his Jabari warriors to defend Wakanda. T'Challa thanks him for coming, and they lead the charge against Thanos's army together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The king who thanks M'Baku for bringing the Jabari to fight.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Brings the Jabari to defend Wakanda at T'Challa's call.

their_evidence: M'Baku was notified by T'Challa of the incoming threat, gathered the Jabari, was thanked by T'Challa for coming, and went into battle with T'Challa and the Wakandan forces.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula and Mantis meet on Ego's planet, where Mantis tells her and Gamora about Ego's dead children. They then fight on the same side against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, who fights beside Mantis against Ego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives with Ego and fights beside Nebula against him.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Nebula's messages bring Mantis and the Guardians to Titan, and Nebula joins the fight against Thanos there. While Mantis holds Thanos under, Nebula reveals that the grief Mantis senses in him is because he has killed Gamora.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Calls the Guardians to Titan and helps Mantis's team pin down Thanos.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Thanos in a trance on Titan while Nebula joins the fight.

their_evidence: Mantis finds Nebula's 23 messages telling the Guardians to come to Titan; on Titan Mantis puts Thanos under and says he is mourning, and the newly arrived Nebula reveals he killed Gamora. Mantis later turns to dust on Titan, with Nebula one of the two survivors there.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis joins the Guardians after Ego's defeat, and when she first sees Rocket she thinks he is a pet and asks to pat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis mistakes for a pet and asks to pat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new teammate who mistakes Rocket for a pet.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Mantis and Rocket are together aboard the Guardians' ship when they pull Thor from the wreckage, and she waves goodbye as Rocket leaves with Thor and Groot for Nidavellir.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis waves off when he leaves with Thor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who waves Rocket off as he leaves with Thor.

their_evidence: Benatar scene: the Guardians including Mantis and Rocket rescue Thor; Rocket decides to go with Thor and Groot, and as they depart in the pod Mantis waves them goodbye.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill is Nick Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss and one of her most trusted friends at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.

stages.title: Secret Invasion#1
stages.text: Hill joins Fury when he comes back to Earth to stop the rogue Skrulls. In Moscow she is shot dead by Gravik, who is wearing Fury's face.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's old boss and friend. She joins his fight against the Skrulls and dies.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand. Gravik shoots her dead in Moscow while wearing his face.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Hill is with Fury on a New York street when people start turning to dust, and she fades away in front of him just before he sends a last signal.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss and friend, who watches her turn to dust.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand, who turns to dust in front of him.

their_evidence: Post-credits scene (belongs to the film): Fury and Hill are monitoring the Wakanda battle; Hill turns to dust in front of Fury, who then activates the pager before vanishing.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff first fight side by side in the Battle of New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's teammate in the Battle of New York.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: They go on the run together when Hydra takes over S.H.I.E.L.D., and they become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Natasha goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Steve goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Steve and Natasha hold the remaining Avengers together for five years, until Natasha gives her life on Vormir.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's close friend, holding the Avengers together with her after the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend, who gives her life on Vormir.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Steve and Natasha, still on the run together, rescue Wanda and Vision from Thanos's forces in Edinburgh, then fight side by side to defend Vision in Wakanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Rescues Wanda and Vision with Natasha in Edinburgh.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights beside Steve in Edinburgh and Wakanda.

their_evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, take them to the Compound and then Wakanda, where they lead the defense together.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross presents the Sokovia Accords to the Avengers, and Natasha signs them. When she helps Steve and Bucky escape at the airport, she becomes a fugitive from Ross.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man behind the Accords, who makes Natasha a fugitive.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An Avenger who signs the Accords, then becomes a fugitive from Ross.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Ross leads the manhunt for Natasha while she is on the run. After she brings down the Red Room, his soldiers surround her, but she escapes his custody.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man leading the manhunt for Natasha, whose custody she escapes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The fugitive Ross hunts, who escapes his custody.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Natasha, Steve and Sam bring Vision to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts them by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them, but Rhodes ends the call.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Natasha's arrest when she returns to the Avengers Compound.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fugitive Ross orders arrested at the Avengers Compound.

their_evidence: Ross, by hologram, confronts the three wanted fugitives (Rogers, Romanoff, Wilson) who arrive at the Compound and orders Rhodes to arrest them; Rhodes cuts the connection.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned Leeds is Peter Parker's best friend from school. Once he learns Peter's secret, he helps him from behind a computer as his guy in the chair.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, whose guy in the chair he becomes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend and guy in the chair.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Ned helps Peter face the villains from other worlds. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, and Ned says a tearful goodbye to his best friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, who erases himself from everyone's memory. Ned says a tearful goodbye.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, who helps him face the villains, then forgets him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Ned, who no longer remembers Peter, tracks Spider-Man's sightings with an app he built. He finally meets the hero face to face, and then meets Peter again.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's forgotten best friend. Ned tracks his Spider-Man sightings, then meets him again.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's forgotten best friend, who tracks Spider-Man with an app he built.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When a spaceship appears over New York during a school field trip, Ned creates a distraction on the bus so Peter can slip away and suit up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Slips off the field trip bus to suit up while Ned covers for him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Covers for Peter on the field trip bus.

their_evidence: From the Midtown field trip bus Peter sees the Q-Ship; Ned provides a distraction while Peter leaves and dons the suit.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye guards Shuri, and the two tease T'Challa together like family.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The princess Okoye guards, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's guard, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Shuri is taken by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Okoye loses her rank, but she returns to fight beside Shuri as a Midnight Angel in the war against Talokan.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The princess taken on Okoye's watch, whom she later fights beside.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's old guard, who loses her rank, then fights beside her as Midnight Angel.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Okoye is in Shuri's lab as Shuri explains how she can remove the Mind Stone from Vision, until an alert warns Okoye of ships entering the atmosphere.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Works to save Vision as Okoye looks on.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Stands by in Shuri's lab while she studies Vision.

their_evidence: Okoye goes into the medical center and watches as Shuri speaks with Rogers, Romanoff, Banner and Maximoff about removing the Mind Stone; Okoye then gets the alert about an alien craft. Same scene, but no direct exchange between the two is described, hence medium.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje, the king's guard, and is T'Challa's closest protector. When Killmonger takes the throne she stays loyal to it at first, then joins T'Challa when he returns to win it back.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king and charge. She returns to his side to win back the throne.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's closest protector and leader of the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Okoye weeps as she helps carry his casket at his funeral.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, whose casket she helps carry when he dies of an illness.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's closest protector, who helps carry his casket at his funeral.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Okoye fights at T'Challa's side in the battle for Wakanda, and when Thanos snaps his fingers T'Challa turns to dust in front of her as he reaches to help her up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, who turns to dust beside her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights at T'Challa's side in Wakanda.

their_evidence: Both lead the Wakandan defense; after the Snap, 'Black Panther, attempting to help Okoye up, fell into ashes before her eyes.'

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot first try to collect the bounty on Peter Quill, and the three end up founding the Guardians of the Galaxy together. Quill and Rocket bicker constantly but become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A bounty turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians' desperate mission to save Rocket's life, and afterward he hands Rocket leadership of the team before going home to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Quill's close friend, whose life he fights to save, and to whom he hands the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's close friend, who saves his life and hands him the team.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Quill and Rocket help pull Thor from space, then the Guardians split up: Rocket flies off with Thor to Nidavellir while Quill leads the others to Knowhere.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves with Thor for Nidavellir as the Guardians split.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the other Guardians to Knowhere as the team splits.

their_evidence: The Guardians rescue Thor; Thor, Rocket and Groot go to Nidavellir while Quill, Gamora, Drax and Mantis go to Knowhere.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Steve Rogers meet while running in Washington and quickly become close friends, and Sam joins his fight against Hydra.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's close friend, met running in Washington.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend, met running in Washington. Joins the fight against Hydra.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the final battle, an aged Steve hands Sam his shield and asks him to carry it on.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's friend. Hands Sam the shield and asks him to carry it on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's friend. Steve hands him the shield and asks him to carry it on.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Sam flies with Steve and Natasha to rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then fights under Steve's lead to defend Vision in Wakanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Sam in the Edinburgh rescue and the fight for Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Flies with Steve to rescue Wanda and Vision.

their_evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision; in Wakanda Falcon warns the Avengers Vision is compromised and Captain America orders Banner and Maximoff to help.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: After the Sokovia Accords fight, Thaddeus Ross has Sam locked up in the Raft.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Locks Sam up in the Raft.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An Avenger Ross locks up in the Raft.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World

their_evidence: Ross is told Vision was rescued by three wanted criminals including Falcon, confronts them at the Compound by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them; Rhodes cuts the connection.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow new Avenger who fights beside Wanda in Lagos and sides with Steve.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's friend. Wong warns him against the spell to make the world forget Peter.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War

stages.title: The Avengers

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old teammate who greets Thor in Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross presents the Sokovia Accords to the Avengers, using Wanda's accident in Lagos as proof they need oversight. After she sides with Steve, Ross has her locked up in the Raft.

question: Tony and Steve never meet or speak here, but Tony carries the phone Steve sent him, says they are not on speaking terms, and nearly calls him before Bruce uses the phone to call Steve. Is that enough for an Infinity War stage?

stages.title: The Avengers

their_evidence: At the farmhouse Fury urges the team to plan; Banner deduces Ultron will force Cho to build him a vibranium body.

their_evidence: Hill calls Barton while he pilots the Quinjet and recommends a hideout; Barton says he knows where to go and takes them to his home.
